## architecture


# Architecture

## Components
- **Menu bar app** (SwiftPM executable `AgentsMissionControl`, bundle `co.tomac.amc`, LSUIElement). evidence: Package.swift, build.sh
  - `MissionControlApp.swift`: entry, the `MissionControl` observable model (polls flag, caffeinate, servers). evidence: Sources/AgentsMissionControl/MissionControlApp.swift
  - `Bar.swift`: the one NSStatusItem pill and pixel art; `Panel.swift`: the glass panel tiles. evidence: Sources/
  - `Privileged.swift`: Unix socket server for privileged sessions. evidence: Sources/AgentsMissionControl/Privileged.swift
- **Scripts** in `bin/`: `amcctl` (flip hands off), `amcd` (enforcer loop), `servers` (localhost listeners as TSV), `amc-call` (socket client). evidence: bin/
- **Claude Code hook** `hooks/hands-off-guard.sh` (PreToolUse on Bash). evidence: install.sh
- **Claude Code plugin** `mod/` (name `amc`): hooks module `mod/hooks/register.tsx`, state contract `mod/types/index.d.ts`; marketplace file at `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. evidence: mod/, .claude-plugin/
- **LaunchAgents** `launchd/*.plist`, templated with `@ROOT@`/`@HOME@` by install.sh. evidence: install.sh
- `swiftbar/`: the retired SwiftBar plugins; the caffeinate tile still calls `swiftbar/caffeinate/caffeinate.5s.sh`. evidence: MissionControlApp.swift#caffeinate

## Data flow: hands off
- The panel and `amcctl` only write or remove `~/.amc/hands-off`; `amcd` and the hook enforce. [IMPORTANT] Keep enforcement out of the UI.

## Data flow: privileged sessions
- Plugin → `bin/amc-call` → `~/.amc/amc.sock` → app. Ops: register, open, run, end, status (one JSON line each way).
- Trust: caller must descend from Anthropic-signed Claude Code (dynamic code-signature check on the live pid); key bound to the claude pid; leases `once` or `session`.
- Commands run as the app's children (`/bin/zsh -c`), so they inherit the app's Full Disk Access; output to `~/.amc/runs/<id>.log`; every request hash-chained into `~/.amc/trace.jsonl`.

## State on disk
- `~/.amc/` (0700): `hands-off`, `amc.sock`, `trace.jsonl`, `runs/`. The key `AMCRoot` in Info.plist points the app at the checkout (scripts run live from the repo). evidence: build.sh, MissionControlApp.swift

## conventions


# Conventions

## Commits
- Imperative subject, often prefixed with the area and a colon (`Caffeinate: …`, `Privileged sessions: …`); body explains why.
- Single branch `main`, no PR flow. evidence: git log (0 merges)

## Languages
- Swift 5.10 tools, macOS 26+, SwiftUI with AppKit status item; no Xcode project. evidence: Package.swift
- Shell scripts are **zsh** (`#!/bin/zsh`, `${0:A:h}` path idioms), never bash. evidence: bin/*, tests/*, build.sh, install.sh
- Plugin is TypeScript/TSX against the `claude-code` hooks API; JSX via `h`. evidence: mod/hooks/register.tsx

## Style
- Comments explain why, one or two lines above the code; no doc-comment blocks. evidence: Sources/*.swift
- Menu bar art is pixel grids drawn live in SwiftUI `Canvas` (no PNG templates), so it follows light and dark. evidence: Bar.swift#Art
- No linter or formatter config in the repo. evidence: gather-evidence (no convention sources)

## workflows


# Workflows

## Build
- `./build.sh` → `build/AgentsMissionControl.app`, signed with the first "Developer ID Application" identity, ad hoc otherwise. evidence: build.sh

## Install
- `./install.sh` (idempotent): build, copy to `~/Applications`, (re)load both LaunchAgents, register the hands-off hook in `~/.claude/settings.json`. evidence: install.sh
- [IMPORTANT] It does not restart a running app: quit it and `open -a ~/Applications/AgentsMissionControl.app`. evidence: install.sh (open -a on a running app is a no-op)

## Test
- `zsh tests/test-hands-off.sh` (18 checks, private flag, safe anytime). evidence: tests/test-hands-off.sh
- `zsh tests/test-privileged.sh` (15 checks, needs the installed app with Full Disk Access; run from a Claude Code session without the plugin: `! zsh tests/test-privileged.sh`). evidence: tests/test-privileged.sh

## Preview UI
- `build/AgentsMissionControl.app/Contents/MacOS/AgentsMissionControl --preview` prints a window number for `screencapture -o -l <n>`; it skips the socket server. evidence: Bar.swift, MissionControlApp.swift

## Plugin
- `claude plugin validate mod` and `claude plugin validate .` (marketplace); run a session with it: `claude --plugin-dir mod`. evidence: mod/, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
- Install for users: `/plugin install amc --marketplace tomacco/agents-mission-control`. evidence: README.md

## Release
- Bump `CFBundleShortVersionString` in build.sh and `version` in mod/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, add a CHANGELOG.md entry, tag `vX.Y.Z`, GitHub release. evidence: CHANGELOG.md, v0.1.0

## Knowledge freshness
- `bash scripts/check-freshness.sh` (pre-commit and CI); after editing `.distill/`, recompile with `bash scripts/render-adapters.sh`. evidence: scripts/

## gotchas


# Gotchas

- [IMPORTANT] Never click the menu bar or post synthetic input to test the UI: a person may be at the keyboard. Use `--preview`. evidence: AGENTS.md
- [IMPORTANT] If `bin/amcctl status` says hands off is on, do not speak, play sounds or drive input, and never turn it off yourself. evidence: AGENTS.md, hooks/hands-off-guard.sh
- Running the tests with `bash` fails (`A: unbound variable`): they are zsh. evidence: tests/*.sh shebang
- An ad-hoc signed build gets a new code identity each build, so macOS drops its Full Disk Access grant. Keep Developer ID signing. evidence: build.sh comment
- Full Disk Access cannot be granted by script; the app is not listed until added with + in System Settings. Granting it makes macOS relaunch the app, which drops every key and lease (the plugin re-registers). The app checks its own access by opening `/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db`. evidence: Privileged.swift#hasFullDiskAccess, 2026-10-15 install
- The privileged session key binds to the first caller in a claude process. `tests/test-privileged.sh` takes it, so the plugin then fails in that same session; and in a session where the plugin loaded first, the test skips the key checks. evidence: Privileged.swift#register, tests/test-privileged.sh
- Plugin hooks module: a helper that receives `$` must be a top-level function, or `claude plugin validate` refuses the module; tool matchers only accept this build's tool names (use a RegExp for several). evidence: mod/hooks/register.tsx
- Changing the bundle id makes a new TCC identity: re-grant permissions and `tccutil reset <service> <old id>` before deleting the old app. evidence: rename commit 593896a

## glossary


# Glossary

- **Hands off**: switch that forbids agents to speak, play sounds or drive mouse and keyboard; the file `~/.amc/hands-off`. evidence: README.md
- **Clawd**: the pixel mascot in the pill and in the plugin pane. evidence: Bar.swift#Art
- **Pill**: the single menu bar status item (Clawd, cup, rack). evidence: README.md
- **amcd**: the enforcer LaunchAgent that kills blocked processes while hands off is on. evidence: bin/amcd
- **Privileged session**: a Claude Code session whose approved commands run inside the app with its Full Disk Access. evidence: README.md
- **Lease**: an approval for a session, scope `once` or `session`. evidence: Privileged.swift#Lease
- **Key**: the secret the app gives the first caller in a claude process; every later op must carry it. evidence: Privileged.swift#register
- **Trace**: `~/.amc/trace.jsonl`, the hash-chained log of every request. evidence: Privileged.swift#trace
- **Mod**: Claude Code's name for a plugin built from a hooks module; here `mod/`, plugin name `amc`. evidence: mod/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
